description.value: La Ruota Pizzeria is a Neapolitan-style pizza chain with multiple BC locations, cooking handcrafted pizzas in a 900°F oven using Caputo '00' flour and ingredients sourced directly from Italy and BC. The West 4th Avenue location sits on a popular cycling corridor through Kitsilano. Online ordering, delivery, and a loyalty rewards program are available.
